title: Reset Ready
style: Pop-punk anthem with driving half-time drums, palm-muted guitars, and chanty group hooks; verse rides tight, punchy lines about the court and warmup routine; pre-chorus strips to claps and bass before a shouted lift; chorus hits with gang vocals on the anchor phrase. Add reverse cymbal swells into each drop, sneaker squeaks and paddle taps as ear candy, and a bright, clean mix with big snare crack and wide vocal doubles on the hook.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Tape on the paddle
Grip feels right
Early on the court
Morning sharp and bright
Bounce that ball twice
Breathe in slow
Eyes on the kitchen
Let the tension go

[Pre-Chorus]
Feet on the line
Mind locked in
Little soft reset
Then I swing again
Hold that shape
Wait, then press
I’m not rushing this
I’m built for stress

[Chorus]
Reset ready
Reset ready
Pro shot, steady
Reset ready
Soft hands, clean feet
Stay on beat
Reset ready
Take the next one neat

[Verse 2]
Dink off the net
Drop it dead
Pick that angle up
Right over their head
Third shot coming
Make it bite
Patience wins the point
When the timing’s right

[Pre-Chorus]
Feet on the line
Mind locked in
Little soft reset
Then I swing again
Hold that shape
Wait, then press
I’m not rushing this
I’m built for stress

[Chorus]
Reset ready
Reset ready
Pro shot, steady
Reset ready
Soft hands, clean feet
Stay on beat
Reset ready
Take the next one neat

[Bridge]
Crowd gets loud
I stay calm
One more touch
Then the point is gone
Low and quiet
Then I rise
Game face on
No wasted tries

[Final Chorus]
Reset ready
Reset ready
Pro shot, steady
Reset ready
Soft hands, clean feet
Stay on beat
Reset ready
Take the next one neat
